configurations.name: opsmap-api-live
runtimeArgs: OPSMAP_BACKEND=turingdb exec uv run uvicorn api.main:app --port 8000

configurations.name: opsmap-api-replay-only
runtimeArgs: OPSMAP_BACKEND=turingdb FEATHERLESS_API_KEY= exec uv run uvicorn api.main:app --port 8000

configurations.name: opsmap-ui-alt
runtimeArgs: OPSMAP_API_TARGET=http://127.0.0.1:8020 exec npm --prefix ui run dev -- --port 5180 --strictPort

configurations.name: dover-resilience-api
runtimeArgs: OPSMAP_BACKEND=turingdb TURINGDB_HOST=http://localhost:6667 TURINGDB_GRAPH=dover TURINGDB_DIR="$PWD/data/dover-runtime" exec .venv/bin/python -m uvicorn api.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8002

configurations.name: dover-resilience-ui
runtimeArgs: OPSMAP_API_TARGET=http://127.0.0.1:8002 VITE_OPSMAP_PROFILE=dover exec npm --prefix ui run dev -- --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5175 --strictPort
